text:
ITEM 1 | Grilled fish fillet with crisp, browned skin and grill marks, pale pink-orange flesh showing flaky layers, lying on the lower left of the plate; footprint roughly 7 x 5 cm, about 1.5 cm thick, with a red pepper strip and green scallion pieces draped over it | 120
ITEM 2 | Roasted root vegetables: orange carrot slices and chunks, golden-brown potato pieces with browned edges, and dark purple-brown wedges, glossy with oil, clustered across the top of the plate in a mound about 10 x 6 cm and 2-3 cm high | 150
ITEM 3 | Scattered fresh green scallion pieces and thin red pepper strips with a few thin pink onion slivers, sitting on top of the fish and vegetables; small pile about 4 x 3 cm, under 1 cm high, slightly moist | 15
ITEM 4 | Roasted potato chunks, golden-yellow with crisp browned edges and fluffy pale interiors, sitting at the right side of the plate; cubes about 2-3 cm, forming a cluster about 6 x 5 cm and 2 cm high | 110
ITEM 5 | Cubed white meat pieces, pale cream with light golden-brown edges, firm and slightly dry, with some shredded strands, arranged on the right side of the plate; cubes about 1.5-2 cm, mound about 9 x 7 cm and 2 cm high | 130
ITEM 6 | Cubed tofu-like pale white pieces, soft-looking with a slightly rough surface, scattered in the lower right area next to the cubed meat; pieces about 1.5-2 cm, spread over about 8 x 6 cm, roughly 1.5 cm high | 90
